coverage.title: Initial readiness and paint receipt
coverage.verified: One pending hero, loaded native text, failed image and denied image. Ready precedes ViewReady, with paint witness 1 and no Complete.

coverage.title: A/B/A source supersession and late completion
coverage.verified: Source generation 3 is superseded; generation 5 stays pending after old job 1 completes. Only job 2 loads g5 and completes. Handle and attachment remain unchanged.

coverage.title: Detach/remount and late completion
coverage.verified: Same handle generation 1; attachment 0 becomes 5; g6 cancellation is not dispatched into attachment 5. Job 3 cannot load g7; job 4 can.

coverage.title: Destroyed ID reuse and late completion
coverage.verified: ID hero reuses slot0 but handle generation1 becomes2 and attachment5 becomes8. Old g8 cancellation dispatched=false; job5 cannot load the new g9; job6 can.

coverage.title: Cancellation is terminal and counts in Complete
coverage.verified: Denied hero g11 cancels, Complete has p0/l1/f1/c2. Job7 completes later with no hero Loaded or repeated Complete before the next source action.

coverage.title: Failure is terminal and counts in Complete
coverage.verified: Actual fixture ImageCache error settles g12 once; Complete has p0/l1/f2/c1.

coverage.title: Drop/remount with host-owned cache
coverage.verified: Drop removes the visible SceneView while cache jobs survive. Engine1 becomes2; fresh Ready/ViewReady occur after a reset witness reaches1. Only new job9 loads engine2 hero g3, then Complete p0/l2/f1/c1.

coverage.title: Repeated redraw and exactly-once stages
coverage.verified: Two redraws after initial completion and after remounted completion were physically performed, as reported by operator. No duplicate milestone records appear; all terminal tickets and per-owner stage keys are unique across all62 records.
coverage.limits: Redraw button emits no explicit action record; its click count is operator evidence, not independently reconstructable from JSON.

coverage.title: External ownership versus Flow leases
coverage.verified: Native cache history survives dropping the view. Five separate adapter tests prove per-adapter Arc release, preservation of external owners, Flow-only decoded lease release, stale Arc rejection and terminal preservation.
coverage.limits: No native heap/RSS inference, backend eviction or hard-cancellation claim.

recommendation.LIF-02: Accept the existing bounded resource readiness/native-paint receipt contract for the validated Linux in-memory ImageCache path, together with existing tracker and adapter tests. No production behavior change was needed.

not_claimed: GPU fence, texture-upload success, or compositor presentation guarantee
Hard cancellation of a shared backend load
Encoded/decoded byte or aggregate background-task budgets
Network/file decoder integration or remote-source authorization beyond the existing resolver policy
Native heap/Arc counts; decoded ownership release is established by targeted unit tests
Pending-view disposal native event dispatch: this run drops a settled failed view; pending disposal remains unit-tested
Paint callback causality from host witness alone: exact SceneView source and stale-frame unit tests establish the receipt path

automated.strict_clippy: Native fixture, UI library/tests and engine resource targets passed
